zh.title: AI 改代码的弱点实录：一个断层，修错三次
zh.description: 让 AI 重做归档页，断层我定位到「2026 头顶的横线」它还是修错。复盘两天人机协作的全过程：AI 改代码的五个弱点，和四条对策。

zh.title: 为什么我让 AI 管我的记忆
zh.description: 给 AI 搭了一套三层记忆系统——长期记忆、短期记忆、语义检索。不只是技术实验，是对「连续性」的思考。

zh.title: 阿里云 ECS 选型与备案实录
zh.description: 从选型、购买、备案到上线，记录一次国内个人服务器上线的完整经历，含备案被卡的教训。

zh.title: 博客现代化改造：噪点、追光、View Transitions 与 Bento
zh.description: 给三年攒下的「效果存量」做一次减法：噪点纹理、边框追光、原生 View Transitions、大标题紧字距、Bento 首页。坑都比效果本身值钱——SPA 导航吃掉 CSS 过渡、:has 特异性、vp-doc 全局样式污染。

zh.title: 我的博客是怎么搭的

zh.title: DeepSeek Harness：一切皆插件的 Agent 框架怎么装
zh.description: DeepSeek Harness 是 DeepSeek 开源的 Agent 运行框架，核心思路是「一切皆插件」。本文覆盖 Node.js 安装与两种 Agent 安装方式（npx 一键启动 + 源码克隆）。

zh.title: 本地大模型部署：从 PC 到服务器，五种方案摆在一起看

zh.title: 我的笔记系统演进史
zh.description: 从备忘录到 Notion 到 Obsidian，再到自己搭的系统。折腾笔记工具的过程本身就是一种思考。

zh.title: OpenClaw 与 Hermes：把 AI Agent 的两种解法拆开看
zh.description: 一个往外接，一个向内省——两种 AI Agent 路线在不同维度上的取舍。

zh.title: 给 AI 加一层「规格书」：OpenSpec 使用体验
zh.description: AI 写代码能力越来越强，但需求只活在聊天记录里。OpenSpec 在人和 AI 之间加了一层轻量规格书，先对齐再动手。这是我的实际使用体验。

zh.title: 从零搭建个人服务器
zh.description: 从买域名、选 VPS、配 Nginx、装 SSL 到部署第一个服务的全过程，适合新手参考。

zh.title: Python 新手入门：环境搭建与第一个项目
zh.description: 从安装解释器到跑起第一个项目，uv/poetry/pip 三个包管理器对照，Windows/macOS/Linux 三平台覆盖。每个命令都能复制粘贴直接跑。

zh.title: 用 Rust 重写我的命令行工具
zh.description: 为什么用 Rust 重写 Python CLI 工具，启动时间从 800ms 降到 12ms，单文件 4.2MB 无依赖。

zh.description: 不蒜子常年半死不活，页脚挂着永远的减号。用 Python 标准库加 SQLite 自建访客统计，零第三方依赖，从写完到上线踩了五个坑，每个都比效果值钱。

zh.title: SSH 安全加固实战
zh.description: 一台暴露公网的服务器，SSH 是唯一的门。改端口、禁 root、配密钥、上 fail2ban，把暴力破解挡在门外。

zh.title: 苏州寒山寺游记
zh.description: 写了半年代码，眼睛累，心里也累。挑个周末自驾去苏州看了寒山寺。

zh.title: 在 VitePress 博客集成 Live2D 看板娘
zh.description: 给博客加只小宠物，记录从选型到上线的几个坑，包括 webpack 拆包加载顺序、tap_body 键名、VitePress Layout slot 限制。

zh.title: 三个 VitePress 定制技巧
zh.description: 给 VitePress 加粒子背景、鼠标光晕和氛围渐变。效果本身很便宜，坑都藏在细节里——DPR、合成层，以及学会不做动画。

zh.title: WorkBuddy：把 AI 从对话框变成工作台
zh.description: 用过很多 AI 工具之后，我发现自己真正缺的不是「更会聊天的模型」，而是能真正动手干活的助手。WorkBuddy 给我的感觉是——它把文件、命令行、浏览器和多模态生成都接到了同一个对话里。

zh.title: 扬州咖啡馆工作指南
zh.description: 测评扬州多家咖啡馆的 WiFi、插座、噪音和咖啡质量，远程工作者的选址指南。

en.title: The Weak Spots of AI Code Editing: One Fault Line, Three Wrong Fixes
en.description: I had AI rebuild my archive page. Even after I pinpointed the bug to the horizontal line above 2026, it still fixed the wrong one. A full retrospective of two days of human-AI collaboration: five weaknesses, four countermeasures.

en.title: Why I Let AI Manage My Memory
en.description: Built a three-layer memory system for AI — long-term memory, short-term memory, semantic search. Not just a tech experiment, it's a reflection on “continuity”.

en.title: Alibaba Cloud ECS: Instance Selection & ICP Filing
en.description: From instance selection, purchase, and ICP filing to going live — a full walkthrough of launching a personal server in mainland China, including the lesson learned from a filing rejection.

en.title: Modernizing This Blog: Noise, Spotlight, View Transitions & Bento
en.description: A subtraction pass over three years of accumulated effects: film-grain noise, spotlight borders, native View Transitions, tighter display type, and a Bento home page. The traps were worth more than the effects — SPA navigation eating CSS transitions, :has specificity, and vp-doc global style pollution.

en.title: How This Blog Is Built
en.description: A walkthrough of the tech stack, theme customization, i18n setup, why I built RSS from scratch, and the performance trade-offs behind every visual effect.

en.title: DeepSeek Harness: Installing the All-Plugins Agent Framework
en.description: DeepSeek Harness is an open-source Agent runtime where every capability is a plugin. This guide covers Node.js setup and two ways to install the Agent (npx one-liner vs. source clone).

en.title: Local LLM Deployment — From PC to Self-Hosted Server, Five Paths Side by Side
en.description: Five typical paths for running models on your own hardware — desktop apps to production inference frameworks, matched to your situation.

en.title: My Notes System Evolution
en.description: From Apple Notes to Notion to Obsidian, then to my own system. The process of tinkering with note tools is itself a form of thinking.

en.title: OpenClaw vs Hermes — Two Approaches to AI Agent Design
en.description: One reaches outward, one reflects inward — two AI Agent paths and their trade-offs across ten dimensions.

en.title: Adding a Spec Layer for AI — My OpenSpec Experience
en.description: AI coding is powerful, but requirements only live in chat history. OpenSpec adds a lightweight spec layer between you and AI — align first, then build. Here's my hands-on experience.

en.title: Building a Personal Server from Scratch
en.description: The whole process from buying a domain, choosing a VPS, configuring Nginx, installing SSL to deploying the first service. Suitable for beginners.

en.title: Python Beginner's Guide: Environment Setup & First Project
en.description: From installing the interpreter to running your first project. Compares uv, poetry, and pip. Covers Windows, macOS, and Linux. Every command is copy-paste ready.

en.title: Rewriting My CLI Tool in Rust
en.description: Why I rewrote a Python CLI tool in Rust, startup time dropped from 800ms to 12ms, single file 4.2MB with zero dependencies.

en.title: Self-Hosting Visitor Stats: Ditching Busuanzi with 200 Lines of Python and SQLite
en.description: The free stats service on my blog footer was half-dead, leaving a permanent dash. I replaced it with a self-hosted counter built on the Python standard library and SQLite — zero dependencies, five pitfalls, each worth more than the feature.

en.title: Hardening SSH on a Fresh Server
en.description: A server exposed to the public internet has one door: SSH. Change the port, disable root login, switch to key auth, and add fail2ban to keep brute-force bots out.

en.title: A Visit to Hanshan Temple in Suzhou
en.description: Half a year of writing code tired out my eyes and my mind. I took a weekend drive to see Hanshan Temple in Suzhou.

en.title: Adding a Live2D Mascot to a VitePress Blog
en.description: How I wired a Live2D model into this VitePress blog, plus the five traps I fell into — webpack split-bundle order, tap_body key naming, VitePress Layout slot limitations, and more.

en.title: Three VitePress Customization Tricks
en.description: Adding a particle background, a cursor glow, and an ambient gradient to VitePress. The effects themselves are cheap — the traps hide in details: DPR, compositing layers, and learning not to animate.

en.title: WorkBuddy: Turning AI from a Chat Box into a Workbench
en.description: After trying plenty of AI tools, what I really lacked wasn't a chattier model — it was an assistant that actually does the work. WorkBuddy feels like it wires the filesystem, the terminal, the browser, and multimodal generation into a single conversation.

en.title: Yangzhou Coffee Shop Work Guide
en.description: Tested multiple coffee shops in Yangzhou for WiFi, outlets, noise, and coffee quality. A location guide for remote workers.
